"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hmac
import time
from hashlib import sha256

COOKIE_NAME = "session"
DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24


def _sign(payload: str, secret: str) -> str:
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), sha256).hexdigest()


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    issued_at = int(time.time())
    payload = f"{user_id}:{issued_at}"
    signature = _sign(payload, secret)
    token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(f"{payload}:{signature}".encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")

    return {
        "name": COOKIE_NAME,
        "value": token,
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Lax",
        "path": "/",
        "max_age": DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS,
    }


def verify_browser_auth_state(token: str, secret: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token.encode("ascii")).decode("utf-8")
        user_id, issued_at, signature = decoded.rsplit(":", 2)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return None

    expected_signature = _sign(f"{user_id}:{issued_at}", secret)
    if not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected_signature):
        return None

    if int(time.time()) - int(issued_at) > DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS:
        return None

    return user_id
